about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer with a passion for building pixel-perfect, engaging, and accessible digital experiences. With over 3 years of experience in the tech industry, I thrive in dynamic environments where I can leverage modern web technologies to solve complex problems and deliver high-quality products.
about.whatIBringToTheTable: What I bring to the table:
about.row1: End-to-end development of responsive web applications
about.row2: Strong focus on UI/UX principles and accessibility standards
about.row3: Experience in designing scalable RESTful APIs and database schemas
about.row4: Agile mindset with a track record of successful team collaborations

skills.moreDescrition: The tech landscape is always shifting, and I make it a priority to stay updated. Recently, I've been diving deeper into Serverless architectures, exploring WebGL for 3D web experiences, and refining my CI/CD pipeline skills.

experience.tagline: My professional journey in software development
experience.moreDescrition: I've worked with startups, agencies, and enterprise teams. Check out my LinkedIn or download my resume for a comprehensive look at my career path.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Leading the frontend development of a SaaS platform for team collaboration. Responsible for architecting reusable component libraries and optimizing rendering performance.
achievements: Spearheaded the migration from Create React App to Next.js, improving SEO and reducing initial load time by 40%
Developed a custom drag-and-drop Kanban board interface using modern web APIs
Mentored junior developers and established standardized code review practices
Collaborated closely with the design team to implement a comprehensive design system

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Developed and maintained various e-commerce and CMS platforms for international clients. Handled both backend API development and frontend integrations.
achievements: Built a headless e-commerce frontend that increased mobile conversion rates by 25%
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express to serve over 10,000 daily active users
Integrated Stripe for seamless payment processing and subscription management
Automated database backups and deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions

jobs.title: Web Developer Intern
jobs.description: Assisted in the creation of landing pages and interactive promotional websites for various marketing campaigns. Focused heavily on CSS animations and responsive design.
achievements: Translated UI/UX wireframes into functional, cross-browser compatible HTML/CSS templates
Implemented complex GSAP animations to enhance user engagement on client landing pages
Assisted in debugging and fixing frontend issues reported by the QA team

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.tagline: A collection of projects that showcase my skills and passion for software development

projectsList.title: Orbit E-Commerce Hub
projectsList.description: A fully functional, modern headless e-commerce platform. Orbit allows users to browse products, manage a shopping cart, and securely checkout. The admin dashboard provides real-time sales metrics and inventory management. Built to demonstrate high-performance web practices and seamless third-party service integration.
features: Server-side rendering for optimal SEO and performance
Complete checkout flow integrated with Stripe webhooks
Admin dashboard with chart visualizations for sales data

projectsList.title: TaskFlow Pro
projectsList.description: A productivity and project management web application tailored for remote teams. TaskFlow Pro features real-time updates, customizable workspaces, and an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for task management. It aims to reduce context switching by keeping all project assets in one unified space.
features: Drag-and-drop task prioritization and status updates
Role-based access control for different team members
Fluid UI animations to enhance the user experience

projectsList.title: WeatherMap 3D
projectsList.description: An interactive, 3D weather visualization tool. Users can spin a 3D globe to select locations and view real-time weather data, forecasts, and climate trends. This project was an exploration into WebGL and integrating complex third-party data streams into a 3D environment.
features: Interactive 3D globe with smooth panning and zooming
Live weather data fetching based on geographical coordinates
Dynamic particle systems to simulate rain and snow visually
Responsive overlay UI built with React
